contract.userJob: Review work items, ownership, approvals, and status without implying an external action occurred.

layout.wide: Align work items with owners, states, approvals, and safe next actions.
layout.compact: Stack each work item with its owner and state while keeping filters secondary.

contract.fallback: Preserve work items, owners, approvals, status, action boundaries, and sources.

gaps: Work items, owners, approvals, filters, and actions lack a coherent state model and visual hierarchy.
The read-only versus consequential-action boundary needs scenario-specific testing.
quality.nextAction: Define a non-consequential review workflow before adding broader action affordances.
